entries.title: Clicking a notification opens its card
entries.body: When you click a notification about a card, Infinitary comes to the front with that card showing, rather than whichever card you last looked at.
entries.noPicture: The change is what a click on a system notification opens, which a still of the window before and after cannot show.

exclusions.reason: Windows is not a supported platform yet: notifications, Start at login, starting by a command through Task Scheduler and dictation's microphone check now work there for the Windows port. Mac and Linux behave as before, apart from the notification click above.
